users.title: Users
users.emptyBody: Clear the search or the status filter, or add a user.
users.denied: You do not have access to users

user.error: This user could not be loaded
user.denied: You do not have access to this user
user.notFound: There is no user at this address
user.mustChange: Must change the temporary password at next sign-in
user.profileHint: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
user.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log with your name.

confirmDisable.title: Disable this account?
confirmDisable.body: {{name}} is signed out of every device and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again.

confirmEnable.title: Enable this account?
confirmEnable.body: {{name}} can sign in again with their current password.

confirmUnlock.title: Unlock this account?
confirmUnlock.body: {{name}} was locked after repeated failed sign-ins. Unlocking lets them try again at once.

confirmReset.title: Reset this password?
confirmReset.body: {{name}} gets a temporary password and must change it at their next sign-in.

temporary.title: Temporary password
temporary.body: Give it to {{name}} in person or by phone. It is shown only now: it will not appear again, here or anywhere else.
temporary.label: Temporary password for {{name}}
temporary.dismiss: I have given it to them

create.title: New user
create.intro: Staff sign in with their email or phone number. They get a temporary password, shown once, and change it at their first sign-in.
create.emailHint: Give an email, a phone number, or both.
create.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +233244512876.
create.invalidEmail: Enter an email address such as name@example.com
create.invalidPhone: Enter the number with its country code, for example +233244512876
create.needContact: Give an email or a phone number
create.optionsError: Roles and branches could not be loaded
create.optionsDenied: You cannot see the roles or branches a new user needs

grants.title: Roles at branches
grants.intro: What this person may do, and where. A change takes effect on their next request.
grants.emptyBody: Without a role this person cannot do anything after signing in.
grants.error: Role grants could not be loaded
grants.denied: You do not have access to role grants
grants.addBody: The role applies at the branch you choose.
grants.revokeBody: {{name}} loses {{role}} at {{branch}} on their next request.

roles.title: Roles
roles.emptyBody: Roles are seeded when the system is installed. If this list is empty, contact support.
roles.denied: You do not have access to roles

role.error: This role could not be loaded
role.denied: You do not have access to this role
role.notFound: There is no role at this address
role.systemNote: A built-in role. It cannot be removed, but its permissions can be changed.
role.name: Role name
role.codeHint: Capital letters and underscores, for example STOCK_CLERK. It cannot change later.
role.invalidCode: Use capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
role.requiresTotp: Require two-step sign-in for this role
role.permissionsHint: Grouped by area. Permissions marked "needs a fresh code" also ask for an authenticator code each time.
role.permissionsDenied: You do not have access to the permission list
role.readOnly: You can see this role but not change it.
role.permissionsTooMany: The permission list is longer than this screen can load
role.permissionsTooManyBody: The role cannot be shown or changed here until support has looked. Nothing has been saved.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Every device signed in, and when it was last used. Revoking one signs that device out on its next request.
sessions.revokeBody: {{name}} on {{device}} is signed out on the next request. Nothing is deleted: the session stays in this list as ended.
sessions.revokeCurrent: This is the device you are using. You will be signed out.
sessions.emptyBody: Nobody is signed in with these filters.
sessions.denied: You do not have access to sessions
